# Synthetic test data

All task titles, names, messages, clocks, UUIDs and example source references in
these tests and scripts are authored synthetic fixtures, not captured personal
responsibilities. Spanish strings exercise optional Spanish UI and conversation
content preservation; English remains the installation default.

No historical run output, private state, screenshot or attachment is distributed.
Tests must use disposable profiles. Any new screenshots require recorded synthetic
provenance and human visual review before publication.
